allergen-quote.name: Allergen Quote
allergen-quote.description: Quote contains, may-contain, and same-kitchen phrases from their matrix for the items they name.

catering-pull.name: Catering Pull
catering-pull.description: Event pull for the date they name: extra prep and order qty from their BEO or pull sheet and from recipe yields they shared.

count-walk-in.name: Count Walk In
count-walk-in.description: Transcribe or check their count sheet, including the shelf map if they filed one.

eighty-six.name: Eighty Six
eighty-six.description: Out items from their board photo or the POS export they named as source of truth.

invoice-match.name: Invoice Match
invoice-match.description: Match the vendor invoice to the order and to receiving notes if they have them.

order-guide.name: Order Guide
order-guide.description: Build an order CSV from counted on-hand versus their par for one vendor and one delivery date.

par-review.name: Par Review
par-review.description: Compare their pars to the recent sales-mix export and to waste rows if those files exist.

prep.name: Prep
prep.description: Prep list for the next shift they name (AM, PM, brunch, or close).

receiving.name: Receiving
receiving.description: Receiving log or marked ticket versus the invoice.

waste-week.name: Waste Week
waste-week.description: Waste from their log for the dates they name, using their reason codes and units.
